slug: 2024-09-06 Mauritius Launches Mobile ID Digital Wallet with Thales - First African ISO-standard Digital ID Wallet

MUS.note: No count or share of people holding the ID is stated.
No number at birth is stated.
Only the Mobile ID wallet is described, not who runs the national ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.
The article describes a wallet built from the physical ID card, not the national ID system itself.
